description: Track, environment, obstacles and collectibles. Owned by lane B (world pieces by lane A).

assets.spec: Tileable crushed-stone ballast under one lane of track. 512x512 PNG/JPG, seamless both axes, viewed from a low grazing angle; tile covers 2.5 m x 2.5 m.
Tileable packed-earth / weedy concrete ground beside the tracks. 512x512, seamless, tile covers ~5 m.
One steel rail, 1 m long along -Z (tiled by the engine), 0.07 m wide, 0.12 m tall, origin at bottom centre. <= 100 tris.
One timber/concrete sleeper (tie) across a lane: 2.3 m wide (X), 0.24 m deep (Z), 0.12 m tall, origin at bottom centre. <= 60 tris, instanced.
Generic yard building/warehouse block, authored as a 1x1x1 m unit cube (scaled per instance), origin at bottom centre. <= 200 tris, uses tex.env.wall.
Tileable corrugated/brick wall panels. 512x512, seamless horizontally.

Low striped track barrier spanning one lane: 2.2 m wide, plank from 0.55 m to 1.05 m above ground, posts at both ends, 0.3 m deep. Must read as 'jump over or roll under'. Origin bottom centre. <= 800 tris.
Diagonal hazard stripes (two high-contrast colours), 256x64, tileable horizontally.

One freight/commuter car occupying a full lane: 2.3 m wide, 3.6 m tall, 13 m long along Z, origin at bottom centre of its footprint, front faces -Z (toward the runner when oncoming). <= 3k tris, 1 material, 1024x512 texture.
Side livery of a train car with windows/doors. 1024x512, wraps once around the car.
Collectible coin, 0.7 m diameter disc facing -Z, 0.08 m thick, origin at centre. <= 300 tris, rendered instanced (single mesh, single material).
